governingPrinciple: The kernel may execute capabilities. It may not contain the capabilities it executes.
decompositionLaw: The subject decomposes into exactly two classes. Bounded SDA responsibilities become canonical capabilities with feature, contracts, semantic execution authority, fixtures, and projected embodiments. Reusable execution mechanics become canonical mechanic authority consumed by execution plans and lowered by each language projector. Nothing in the subject remains Node-owned semantic meaning; helper operations live beneath scenario execution authority, never as capabilities.
authoringOrder: Canonical write-ups precede code. The feature/gherkin write-ups for both capability designs and the mechanic authority write-ups are authored and digest-pinned first; the frozen implementation remains the behavioral oracle for fixtures. No further native body extraction or registry work proceeds until the write-ups are admitted.

mechanicAuthorityRefs.note: 33 pure semantic operations (path, bind-path, literal, object, array, object-values, merge, map, flat-map, filter, find, some, every, includes, intersects, equals, length, greater-than, if, let, unique, join, format, escape-html, base64-decode-utf8, json-stringify, parse-json, try-parse-json, canonicalize, sha256, canonical-json-byte-validation, retained-lineage-authorization, canonical-artifact-byte-planning).

17 physical effect mechanics (read-file-bytes, write-file-bytes, write-file-atomically, rename-file, create-directory, list-directory, file-exists, file-stat, file-lstat, realpath, read-environment-credential, perform-http-exchange, execute-bounded-process, read-clock, generate-random-identity, exclusive-create-or-exact-match, atomic-current-pointer-compare-and-swap).

planes.KERNEL: Language-neutral execution law only: admit input, resolve event authority, execute event authority, admit outcome, resolve disposition, propagate lineage, emit testimony.
planes.PROJECTED_PLATFORM_CAPABILITY: Bounded platform meaning expressed as ordinary SDA capability, projected like any other.
planes.PRIMITIVE_MECHANIC_AUTHORITY: Physical mechanics declared canonically (read-file-bytes, compute-sha256, read-clock, generate-random-identity). Their meaning is fixed by authority; their per-language lowering belongs to the language projector. No language runtime may become their semantic home.
planes.NATIVE_FLOOR_WITH_CANONICAL_CORPUS: Mechanic whose body stays native only while the projector cannot yet lower it; its meaning is fixed by a canonical cross-target conformance corpus.
planes.PROJECTED_ARTIFACT: Generated from admitted authority rather than hand-edited.
planes.IRREDUCIBLE_NATIVE: The language projector only: the sole floor that knows how each canonical primitive mechanic lowers into a target language (crypto.createHash for Node, SHA256 for C#, hashlib for Python, MessageDigest for Java, sha256 for Go).

capabilityDesigns.responsibility: Realize the mechanics declared by an admitted SDA execution plan in a target language without allowing the target language to invent capability meaning.

scenarios.note: Contract selection and admission decision are projected; the validation engine remains an admitted native engine (AJV) as the irreducible validation provider.

The evaluator body cannot be projected without circularity because it is what evaluates projected transformation authority. Its semantics move into a canonical per-operation conformance corpus that every target must satisfy.
Superseded later by the admitted lossless Gherkin compiler; this exists so the line scanner can be retired against equivalent fixtures.
Must be paired with repinning: each provider authority pins only its own module, never the shared registry artifact. Admitting a mechanic becomes catalog admission, not a source edit.

capabilityDesigns.responsibility: Determine whether an observed execution-plan realization actually conformed to authority. Provider and verifier remain separate responsibilities.

scenarios.note: Declared conformance law: every required execution mechanic must resolve to an admitted platform capability for the projection target; the platform-mechanic-resolution closure must be RESOLVED with every resolution AVAILABLE.

Declared conformance law: canonical required mechanics minus each admitted target's projected mechanics must be empty; mechanics embodied in only one target without an explicit target-specific declaration are LANGUAGE_MECHANIC_PARITY_FAILURE; a missing target projection is CROSS_APPLY_INCOMPLETE. This scenario prevents the subject from happening again.
Declared conformance law: the same canonical fixtures must produce equivalent canonical outcomes and equivalent testimony across every admitted target.

supersededAtomizedCandidates: The seventeen per-mechanic candidate features under candidates/superseded-atomized-candidates/ were folded into the two capability designs above: each former candidate became a scenario (or a scenario family) beneath realize-sda-execution-plan-mechanics or verify-sda-execution-plan-realization, and its helper operations became execution mechanics beneath scenario execution authority.

primitiveMechanicAuthorities.note: Canonical dotted-path access; each target lowers it to native member/index access.
Canonical dotted-path binding with prototype-pollution rejection; lowered per target.
Recursive sorted-key canonicalization; lowered per target.
SHA-256 over canonical JSON encoding; Node crypto, C# SHA256, Python hashlib, Java MessageDigest, Go sha256.
Effect-context plumbing primitive carrying admitted bounds (credential store, clock, random identity, fetch) to lowered providers.
Clock reading inside governed effect context; lowered per target.

irreducibleFloor.reason: The sole irreducible floor. Owns primitive mechanic lowering per target; everything above it is declared authority.

sequencing: Repin every provider authority to its own provider module before extracting anything, because until that lands each extraction that touches the shared registry invalidates every prior provider admission.
Admit the two capability designs, then extract their scenarios in family order, each against the frozen implementation's own fixtures.
Project the language mechanic registry only after repinning, so generation does not reproduce the coupling in generated form.
Retire each native body only after the projected replacement satisfies the frozen implementation's own fixtures.
Author the transformation-operation conformance corpus so the native evaluator floor is pinned by canonical per-operation fixtures across targets.
acceptanceConditions: Every extraction leaves every issued wave conformance receipt byte-identical.
The frozen current implementation and the projected replacement produce equivalent canonical outcomes and equivalent testimony against the same fixtures.
Lineage is preserved across the replacement and mechanical sterility passes.

Universal mechanic parity holds: for every declared universal mechanic, the embodied-mechanic set of each admitted target equals the Node set; a target missing a universal mechanic is CROSS_APPLY_INCOMPLETE, and a mechanic embodied in only one target without an explicit target-specific declaration is LANGUAGE_MECHANIC_PARITY_FAILURE.

Provider and verifier remain separate capabilities: no scenario in realize-sda-execution-plan-mechanics may evaluate conformance, and no scenario in verify-sda-execution-plan-realization may produce effects.
Completion is declared on kernel meaning reaching zero, not on the file becoming smaller.

The registry is now declared data (node-mechanic-registry.authority.v1.json) read by a runtime loader (node-mechanic-registry-loader.mjs) that imports the 16 admitted provider modules; adding a mechanic is authority admission, not a source edit.
